title: Printing and Spreading the Books of Rabbainu

segments.he:
יג
"ספרי רבינו ז"ל", ילמוד בכל יום ובזה מתקשר לדעתו הקדושה וממשיך עליו כח דקדושה לילך בדרכי הצדיק ומביא כל העולם לתשובה:
segments.en: This is a great root and foundation — for through it all of the House of Yisroel can draw close to the path of truth, which is the purpose of our existence and of all the worlds. Therefore this work must be for those close to the Tzaddik a Kodesh Kodoshim — they must engage in it with all their powers for its own sake — and at every opportunity seek counsel on how to expand it and spread his springs outward, to revive and restore the soul of all Yisroel to their Father in Heaven.
